sar_narrative: Entity SYN_94c6d814 exhibited suspicious activity consistent with layering and pass-through behavior. Between 2026-04-03 and 2026-04-06, the entity conducted 8 wire transfers totaling $25,419,576.49 to various counterparties, including YQXMO Solutions LLC ($3,686,534.23), ZTLC Enterprises LLC ($3,507,252.23), and RLHZW Holdings LLC ($2,737,879.94). All transactions were noted as 'peel-chain hop,' indicating a rapid movement of funds in descending amounts. Upon verification, the auxiliary numeric finding of $21,403,276.67 is inconsistent with the underlying transactions; the re-derived total volume is $25,419,576.49, which represents a vs_declared_volume_ratio of 12.74 times the expected monthly volume of $1,995,456. This high velocity and volume ratio warrant further investigation. We refer this matter to a human investigator.
